title: Title screen frame
subject: two noblemen of a thirteenth century court facing each other in silent rivalry across an empty page: at the lower left a crowned king in his prime seen in profile from the chest up, dark beard, a gold crown set with coloured stones, a deep blue wool mantle, chin resting on one closed hand as he looks up and across toward the upper right; at the upper right a grey-bearded old counsellor in a slate-blue robe seen from the chest up, one hand at his beard, gazing back down at the king; a small gold crown ornament at the top centre of the border and a rampant gold lion in the lower right corner of the border
